trailhead.label: The car park at the end of the road in Case di Viso, Ponte di Legno, the published start

cautions: The last 0.2 km up to the Rifugio Bozzi is a mountain path (T2), rocky underfoot: keep your dog close and let it pick its footing.
There is no shade and no water on the way up to 2,475 m: carry water for your dog and rest it in the hut’s basin.
Storms build fast at this height in summer: check the forecast and turn back if the sky darkens.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
